changes.concreteBoxes: buildingLayout places partial wall boxes from wallSpan originOffsetMm, clearLengthMm, and clearHeightMm; anchors resolve to support-column faces, floor, and upper-girder underside.
changes.rebarOrigin: buildingLayout translates range-local wall Rebar.points by the same along/height extent origin; domain coordinates remain unchanged. Member view already consumes the range-local dimensions directly.
changes.openings: buildingLayout passes the extent world origin to boxHoles, while clipSegments and carveBox continue to consume range-local opening coordinates without a second deduction or shift.
changes.plan: PlanEditor draws a horizontal wall only across its extent and adds an existing-system label for vertical/horizontal extents (for example, 腰壁 H=900).
